description: One Air65 II Racing 0702 2026 motor with short silver bell, open purple crown, visible copper and mounting hardware. XY origin is shaft axis; local Z is aircraft frame datum.

provenance.feature: motor outside diameter, body stack and exposed shaft
provenance.note: Uses frozen 9 mm OD, 8.55 mm mounting-base-to-shoulder height, 1 mm shaft and 3.4 mm extension. The orange motor in the dimension image supplies family geometry; current Racing colors come from its own product imagery.

Z locations follow the architecture estimated base z=2.7 mm and derived shoulder z=11.25 mm; the local bolt triangle is +Y first on the verified 6.6 mm PCD. Main assembly rotates whole motor to align the matching frame pad.

provenance.feature: bell, rim, neck and lower terminal plate subpart dimensions
provenance.note: Family image proportions split the full stack: base 2.70-3.75, terminal plate 3.84-4.31, tapered neck 4.31-5.76, silver bell 5.75-9.32, open crown 9.28-10.89, shoulder 11.25 mm. These subpart coordinates are image-based, not manufacturer dimensions.

Three raised curved crown spokes and nine 13-turn coil packs recreate visible openings and copper. Exact spoke topology, tooth count, coil turns, wire gauge geometry and internal magnets were not measured; hidden internal magnets are omitted.
Brass bushing family is sourced; geometric bushing, axle-retainer and screw-head dimensions are estimates. The 1.8 mm screw heads have visible recessed cruciform faces under the motor pads.
Local 0.04-0.10 mm bevels and material appearance are cosmetic estimates. No connecting wire path or connector is included; integration owns routing.
